classifiedDifferences.detail: Foundry stores invocation acquisition as an ItemChoice pool of feat-like documents; Oracle stores SRD invocations as canonical feature entities in a replaceable EntityCollection.
Foundry expresses class/subclass grants through Advancement documents; Oracle references canonical features from level advancement rows.
Foundry keeps Pact Magic progression partly in class advancement/configuration; Oracle keeps the pact slot pool and its short/long-rest recovery explicitly on Pact Magic.
